sql.value: select aum.id, aum.opus_id as opusId, ao.name_cn as opusName, ao.cover_url as coverUrl, aum.episode_key as episodeKey, aum.episode_no as episodeNo, if(aum.episode_no is null, 1, 0) as isExtra, ifnull(am.display_name, aum.episode_key) as displayName, aum.media_id as mediaId, aum.source, aum.create_time from ani_opus_update aum left join ani_opus ao on ao.id = aum.opus_id left join ani_media am on am.id = aum.media_id where aum.is_deleted = 0 #[and aum.opus_id = :opusId] #[and aum.create_time >= :start] #[and aum.create_time <= :end] order by aum.create_time desc, aum.id desc
